name: The Plough Rights
summary: A plains clan that holds no plot and no office, only a numbered place in a queue for tenure, because on ground where distance is not conserved the plough, the roof and the levy are three claims on the same hands. It exists because a family with no queue slot has no claim at all, and the queue cannot be shortened by anybody.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: cultures.plain_dweller: tenure is a queue, not an office
politics.trial_of_the_ford: an oath sworn at a crossing is re-earned against a river that moves

attributes.what_the_family_owns: a numbered place in a revocable queue, reassigned at every flood
attributes.what_it_cannot_do: lease, mortgage or sell the slot, because the flood that relocates a settlement relocates the queue with it
attributes.the_cost_it_pays: three seasons of levying for every season of holding, paid in grain the collector cannot inflate
attributes.why_a_family_and_not_a_guild: the queue is inherited, so the household that waits pays for the household that inherits, which is the only obligation here that survives a flood

name: The Widow Run Kin
summary: The household form of an absence: partners left on the plains when the cultivators went up the Tier Stair, holding the name of somebody who is not here and refusing to fill the gap. It exists because the movement was economic before it was spiritual, and a name with nobody in it is still a name, so they keep it dated rather than counting a child of the absent twice.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: cultures.plains_widows: the first culture built out of an absence
history.migration_the_peak_ascent: the movement was economic before it was spiritual

attributes.what_it_holds: the names of the absent, kept in the order they left rather than the order they were born
attributes.the_rule_it_will_not_break: no child of the absent is entered twice, which is why the line grows at half the rate its neighbours do
attributes.what_it_owes: a crossing it cannot pay for, because the dues are collected at a ford the absent used to work
attributes.why_they_did_not_go: the absent left a claim on the crop and a claim on the ferry, and only one of those can be carried up a stair

name: The Standing Ear
summary: The other half of the same absence, holding the crop the absent left a claim to instead of the absent's name. It exists because a household with no cultivator still has an estate, and an estate needs somebody standing at the threshing floor to collect it, and because grain is the only thing anybody will accept as payment for a crossing.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: economy.ferry_dues: a toll denominated in the payer's own crop cannot be inflated
politics.passage_tariff_treaty: a crossing is paid in grain and never in coin

attributes.what_it_holds: the standing claim to the threshing floor and the dues owed out of it
attributes.the_price_of_the_claim: it is paid in the payer's own crop, so the price of a crossing cannot be inflated by whoever collects it
attributes.what_makes_it_rival_the_widow_run_kin: one holds the name, one holds the dues, and the charter of the run recognises both and pays neither twice
attributes.why_it_is_leaner: a household with no absent member has no reason to keep a genealogy, so its record is the floor ledger and nothing else

name: The Tidecull Keepers
summary: A house that culled its own branches rather than marrying out of them, because a line held pure inside one household concentrates faster than the same line spread across a village, and a cull is the only lever an indebted house has. It exists because the concentration it kept is real and the siblings it stopped paying for were people.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: history.decree_the_branch_cull: a cull is the only way to stop paying for siblings
cultures.debt_line: every child bound to a named debt before first breath was drawn cold

attributes.the_instrument: a lineage cull under cultivation debt, applied before a sibling's first ascent could be funded
attributes.what_it_gained: a narrowed line whose grant is sustained rather than sudden, selected under debt and never designed
attributes.what_it_costs_now: the March charter names one line for the River Lantern and that line is this one, so the house is heir to a seat its own cull emptied
attributes.why_it_did_not_marry_out: marriage out would dilute the concentration by exactly the margin the cull was meant to remove, so the two remedies were one remedy

name: The Thorn Hosts
summary: A clan whose kinship is a partnership rather than a descent: the host holds a share of a living thorn line and the thorn holds a share of the host's survival, so a marriage here is a hedge written by both parties. It exists because the symbiote is not carried in blood and cannot be inherited, so it has to be re-signed every generation.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: races.thornline is a symbiote, not a descent, so it cannot be inherited
races.thornhost: the hybrid is a partnership, and the partnership has to be rewritten each generation

attributes.what_the_household_actually_owns: a share in a body that can leave, which is the only asset on any roll here that cannot be walled
attributes.how_the_bond_is_made: a signed pairing between two lines, renewed each generation, because nothing in a symbiote survives a death without renegotiation
attributes.what_breaks_it: a host that refuses a pairing loses the share, and a thorn without a host goes feral inside one season
attributes.why_it_is_never_a_race: the host is not a different kind of person; the host is a person who has made a different promise

name: The Longmarrow Seats
summary: A clan whose members live long enough that nobody living is the eldest, so it has no head and has never had one: the oldest decides nothing and the household runs on a queue of precedence in which everyone present outranks everyone absent. It exists because a three-century overlap turns inheritance into a problem of attendance rather than of birth order.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: races.longmarrow native to the spirit peaks
cosmology.temporal_law is what writes a clock that keeps time

attributes.why_there_is_no_head: a lifespan that outlasts the memory of any one member's predecessors, so authority cannot be personal and never was
attributes.how_it_is_governed: by attendance: whoever is present at a decision outranks whoever is not, which is the only seniority a body this old can measure
attributes.what_it_owes_each_generation: an hour of presence per period, the same cost the mutual society charges and for the same reason
attributes.the_cost_of_the_longevity: the living population is a standing quorum, so the house can never disperse, retire or be dispersed

name: The Salt Crossers
summary: One recorded pairing between a salt body and a tide body, repeated until the household no longer surveys as either. It exists because the crossing was crossed once, written down, and every household that repeated it produced a body a surveyor would file under a different race, so four generations have spent themselves correcting a census entry.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: races.brinecaller is the authored salt-and-tide hybrid
civilizations.brine_reach: a salt dominion's territory is exactly its waterline

attributes.the_pairing_that_made_it: one documented salt-and-tide crossing, which is the authored bar; two generations of pure pairing is the most any line here has held
attributes.what_the_correction_costs: a household cannot be sworn into a line it is being surveyed out of, and every correction is a season of standing, which is what crossings are paid in
attributes.why_they_did_not_stop_repeating: the crosser's body reads the brine without harm, so it is the only pairing on the shelf whose children can work the tailings at all
attributes.what_the_family_will_not_do: call the result a race, because a race is what the survey says and the survey is the thing they are correcting

name: The Quenchbound
summary: A house where every child is signed to a furnace before it is named, because a fire-affinity body with no seated elemental law has no budget to draw on and must burn its own reserve. It exists because the reserve is short, the lifespan is fifty years, and a signature is the only inheritance that survives a body which will not.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: cultures.quench_order: closing permanently the moment the body is lit
cosmology.unwritten_law: an unimprinted group is absent, and absence has exactly three signatures

attributes.the_instrument: a signature against a furnace, taken at naming and discharged by nothing short of the body's own closure
attributes.what_it_is_for: planning a reserve that has to be spent deliberately, because a body with nothing beneath it overflows into flesh that cannot be repaired
attributes.what_the_house_inherits: not the reserve but the plan; the furnace outlives its occupant and the plan is what the next child is handed
attributes.why_the_discipline_is_not_a_school: closing permanently cannot be unlearned, so it is a household contract and not a teaching anybody is allowed to leave

name: The Cinder Marked
summary: The households the Cinder Famine left, still holding themselves to the eating rules of the year there was nothing to eat. It exists because a famine imposes its manners fastest on those too young to remember the reason, and a rule learned in infancy outlives the belief that prompted it, so the table is still set for a shortage that ended a century ago.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: cultures.cinder_mark: the scar that behaves like a people
history.disaster_the_cinder_famine: speed bought out of lifespan

attributes.the_rule_they_keep: the year's portioning, applied to every table including the ones that now have enough
attributes.why_the_rule_outlived_the_need: it was learned before anyone could ask why, so it is carried as habit rather than argument and cannot be argued out of a child
attributes.what_it_costs_now: a household that eats to rule cannot take a larger share than the worst year allowed, which is a real ceiling on every child it raises
attributes.what_the_famine_actually_was: speed bought out of lifespan, a population whose fuel is its own body thinning at exactly the rate it could not stop

name: The Iron Grief Heirs
summary: The households that were working the seam when it ran out, now holding the worked-out face as a title. It exists because a claim to a dead resource is the only claim the plains can still honour, and honouring a dead claim is cheaper than paying a living one, so the grief became an estate.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: history.disaster_the_iron_grief: one exhausted seam cost the tier its whole ladder
geography.ironhead_flats: the argument is over which side of them a household may live on

attributes.what_the_household_owns: the exhausted face, which yields nothing and cannot be occupied and is therefore uncontested
attributes.how_the_claim_is_kept: by working the dead ground: measuring it, marking it, keeping the marks legible, because an unmeasured claim is not a claim
attributes.why_the_guild_resents_them: the guild works the last unworked iron, and every survey this house keeps is a survey that names where the seam is not
attributes.what_the_grief_was: the tier's only caging ore ran out and no spatial law was seated to open fresh rock, so the whole mortal ladder closed at once

name: The Heap Clan
summary: A tenancy with no land under it: what the clan holds is a crew and a number on a public tally of spoil moved, and the number is the only title the flats recognise. It exists because spatial law is unspent here, so waste does not disperse and forty years of heap has to be carried out by hand before the face can advance a foot.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: organizations.spoilwright: spoil does not disperse where spatial law is unspent
cosmology.unwritten_law: no process runs on an unimprinted group

attributes.what_the_clan_owns: a place on a public tally and the debt attached to it
attributes.the_price_of_leaving: you owe the heap you did not move and the tally stays up, so a defector's name sits against a number that only goes down
attributes.why_the_tally_is_public: it is a weight and not a distance, and a weight is the one measurement this tier can support
attributes.the_law_that_made_it: with no spatial law there is no process on which waste disperses, so a spent seam is visible from outside and a resource can be seen to end

name: The Face Lease
summary: A clan holding the lease on a working face at the Ironhead Flats and standing on its own ground as a visitor, because nothing native to the mortal tier is licensed to work a seam. It exists because the lease has to expire every season: a visitor's claim on ground the frame considers foreign cannot be held long enough to become a right.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: cosmology.mortal_world licenses no humanoid, so every body at a face is a visitor
economy.gate_fee: the only tax this tier can collect, charged to a man for standing on his own claim

attributes.what_the_lease_is: a seasonal claim on a face, renewable by whoever meets the shift, lapsing if the holder is off the ground when it falls due
attributes.why_it_expires_every_season: a world that licenses no humanoid treats every body on it as an arrival, so nothing arranged here outlasts the frame's tolerance
attributes.what_the_clan_pays: the gate fee, charged for watching a trial it cannot attempt and for standing on a claim it cannot own
attributes.what_the_lease_is_not: ownership; nobody may own ground on a frame where levying a person is the one thing the law forbids

name: The Deadwatch Kin
summary: A household whose members are entered into the year's dead as one declared group rather than kept on a family roll, because the Cinder Famine made every individual short of fuel and the shortfall collective at once. It exists because a fifty-year body produces no growing store of the long-lived, so what a family keeps is the year's dead together.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: cultures.deadwatch: holds the year's dead together as a declared group
organizations.field_registry: reads the dead as the frame said, not as the village remembers

attributes.how_membership_works: a member is entered on the year's list with the group and leaves nothing behind that could be inherited
attributes.what_the_house_keeps: the divergence between the frame's reading of a life and the village's memory, which is permitted to differ and is recorded rather than resolved
attributes.why_the_fifty_years_matter: a body whose fuel is its own furnace thins at the rate it cannot stop, so a roll of the living would be a roll of the absent
attributes.the_law_that_causes_it: with no elemental law seated beneath them the fastest bodies have no budget to spend into and every overflow is absorbed by flesh that cannot be repaired

name: The Register Keepers
summary: The household that keeps the recovery register of a great ascension: the whole reading published, the fragments never displayed again. It exists because a fire-affinity body opened on a purpose leaves debris and a record, and the culture keeps no temple and no museum, so the register is the only relic and it has to live somewhere with somebody accountable for it.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: cultures.ash_register: the register is the only relic the culture keeps
geography.loot_ember_vault_domain: dead ground is where the setting keeps its records

attributes.what_the_house_holds: the register itself, and the sole right to read it aloud
attributes.why_the_fragments_are_never_shown: a fragment is the only relic that can be carried off, so displaying one is displaying the loss twice
attributes.the_cost_the_house_pays: its name is on the page, so when a reading is wrong the correction is public and personal
attributes.why_it_is_a_household_and_not_a_college: a college could keep the page; only a household answers for the person named on it, and that is the whole obligation

name: The Vault Foundlings
summary: Children raised by the register household after a failed ascent, because the debris from an opened body is the household's responsibility and the households of the dead are not there to ask. It exists because a great ascension injures the ground as well as the body, and the reading is published, so the reading names exactly who has nowhere to go.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: geography.terrace_ring: a failed breakthrough injures the ground as well as the body
cultures.ash_register records the whole recovery publicly

attributes.how_the_line_forms: by intake at a reading rather than by birth, and the intake is published with the same care as the loss
attributes.what_the_fosters_owe: the name on the register, and a household that cannot produce one is not permitted to keep the child
attributes.why_a_foster_line_is_not_a_clan: no descent connects them, so the line has to re-earn its continuity every generation out loud
attributes.what_the_children_inherit: a reading and a name; nothing else was ever there to inherit

name: The Cinder Foster
summary: A line formed by adoption rather than birth, because the famine took the people who could have borne children and the households that survived had none of their own to lose. It exists because a fifty-year body dies of a shortage decades before it dies of age, and the arithmetic leaves the fertile years empty and the dependents full.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: history.disaster_the_cinder_famine: thinning at exactly the rate it could not stop
cultures.debt_line: the alternative household answer to the same shortage was a cull, not an adoption

attributes.the_forming_event: a generation in which nobody could afford to raise a child and everybody could afford to take one
attributes.how_succession_works: by taken-in rather than born-out, so the household's own contribution to its continuity is a debt it never has to name
attributes.what_it_gives_up: the concentration a line gains by staying inside itself, which is why this line is broad and shallow where the culled houses are narrow and deep
attributes.why_it_is_not_a_foster_line: a foster line takes children in beside its own; this one has no own, and the household is the adoption

name: The Stair-Bred
summary: Children raised on the graded route itself, by whichever household holds the term, so that nobody on it belongs to a tier long enough to be sent back down. It exists because distance is not conserved on the plains and a road that measures itself is the only repeatable departure there, which makes the stair a portable institution with a constituency on four tiers.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: geography.tier_stair: the first portable institution in the setting
organizations.ninth_watch: a queue of unlicensed arrivals is the one thing that must not become a fight

attributes.what_raises_them: the term-holder's household, for the length of the term and no longer
attributes.what_they_inherit: a term rather than an estate, because nothing on the stair survives the season that granted it
attributes.why_a_household_is_needed_at_all: somebody has to feed a child through a crossing, and the crossing is the only thing the stair does
attributes.what_they_are_not: not a tier's people; the stair licenses no origin because it is measured, and a measurement does not ask where anybody came from

name: The Seventeen House
summary: A household made entirely of people who did not descend from it: every member came from a lineage that stopped one gate short of the ceiling and had no cultivator left to produce. It exists because a fixed dense body forms its cavity at seventeen and cannot form the next one, so the unlucky half of the setting's population is its own largest supply of competent strangers.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: history.consequence_the_density_ceiling: densest bodies stop at seventeen, one gate short
cultures.stonewright: a fixed dense body can carry and lift in a way nothing else here can

attributes.the_gap_they_fill: the parents who reached the density ceiling and had no cultivator left to produce
attributes.how_membership_is_earned: by arriving at seventeen and being taken in, which is the only credential the house accepts
attributes.what_the_house_is_for: keeping a competence the ladder has no next gate for, so the work of a seventeen-year body is done by somebody who stopped and stayed
attributes.why_it_is_a_foster_line_and_not_a_school: a school teaches the next gate; there is no next gate, so the house takes the person whole

name: The River Lantern Line
summary: The single line the March charter names for the Keeper of the River Lantern, reduced to one thread by a cull that stopped the house paying for siblings. It exists because the seat's succession is an heir under a charter rather than an appointment, so the vacancy is not an oversight but what is left when an arithmetic decision about money meets an office nobody can fill.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: politics.vacant_lantern_seat: the charter names a line, so the vacancy is arithmetic
politics.seat_trial_rule: every appointment passes a trial the naming office cannot judge

attributes.what_the_charter_names: this line and only this line, which is why the vacancy has a shape instead of being an absence
attributes.how_thin_the_line_is: one thread, kept thin on purpose, because the concentration was worth more than the siblings it cost
attributes.what_the_line_owes_the_seat: nothing while it is vacant and everything the moment a trial it cannot judge succeeds, which is why nobody in the line has ever been tried
attributes.the_office: the Keeper of the River Lantern, unfilled for two generations and written as existing with no value rather than as a zero

name: The Empty Seat Heirs
summary: A line whose ancestor once held one of the engraved terraces and whose descendants hold an asset that cannot be sold, cannot be proven and pays upkeep on nothing. It exists because four immortal seats and nine transcendent seats stand vacant and no procedure can certify any of them empty, so an unoccupied seat is still a title and the only thing it pays is the cost of being argued about.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: history.consequence_the_unfilled_ledger: no procedure can certify any seat empty
geography.terrace_of_nine_seats: the vacancies are physical, an engraved absence

attributes.what_the_family_holds: a vacancy with a name attached, which is a claim that cannot be exercised and cannot be abandoned
attributes.why_the_vacancy_cannot_be_certified: nothing here can read a seat as empty without filling it, and filling it is the one act the highest office is forbidden to perform
attributes.what_it_costs: attendance at the terrace every period, because an inherited vacancy is only held by being seen to hold it
attributes.the_state_it_lives_in: a vacancy is not a zero and not an absent row; it is a third thing, and a family whose asset is a third thing cannot be written on a ledger

name: The Gilded Core Wardens
summary: A line that guards one founder's forge relic and nothing else, and has refused every offer to sell, lend or exhibit it. It exists because metallurgy was the first real bottleneck in the setting, a core has to be caged in something, and the third gate was a mining problem long before it was a spiritual one, so the object that made the ladder climbable is worth more than the ground it stands on.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: history.era_the_gilded_core: the third gate was a mining problem first
geography.exhausted_seam requires the gilded core era, so the iron bed is now spent

attributes.what_the_line_guards: a single founder's relic, kept cold and unworn, because an object that is used cannot be shown to be the same object
attributes.why_they_refuse_sale: a sold relic becomes somebody's claim, and a claim somebody else may enforce is not a heritage
attributes.what_they_do_in_exchange: they answer one question a year for whoever is sent, which is the whole public function of the line
attributes.the_reason_it_is_a_wardenship: the metal that made the first cores was smelted at a hearth that no longer stands, so the line is the archive of a technique and the archive is a person

name: The Quartermark Reeves
summary: A family that has published the crossing schedule for six tides of the Cloudshelf Sea and therefore holds the one office in the setting nobody can seize: the calendar. It exists because the window is set by the anchored season rather than by the holder's preference, and a toll with a defensible price is only defensible if the date is not the holder's.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: civilizations.gale_toll: the holder sets the price and never the date
geography.tidemark_climate: a calendar is the first form of wealth

attributes.what_the_family_holds: the reading of the Tidemark, and therefore the shipping dates obeyed by people who never heard of the author
attributes.how_the_office_survives: the holder sets the price and never the date, so the family cannot be blamed for a closed pass
attributes.what_six_tides_of_ownership_cost: each crossing of the sea is a generation of the family's life on the tide tier's clock, and a date nobody may argue is the only thing that compounds
attributes.why_they_do_not_hold_the_pass: ground and schedule are deliberately in two hands; one family holding both would make the corridor unarguable, and an unarguable corridor gets stormed

name: The Sixth Seat Keepers
summary: A dynasty whose entire office is the surplus: it holds the seats that were opened and never needed, and its members' standing is measured by how little of the world's capacity they have claimed. It exists because ten seats over six groups leaves four duplicate imprints and a duplicate needs somewhere to sit, so somebody's family has to hold the surplus without spending it.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: cosmology.slot_budget: six groups cannot fill 3/6/10/15, so layers make the budgets mean anything
history.era_the_nine_empty_seats: an era whose defining fact is a set of unfilled high seats

attributes.what_the_family_administers: the duplicate imprints, which have to be held by somebody and can be argued about by nobody else
attributes.how_standing_is_measured: by capacity not claimed, so the family's rank falls every period it uses a seat and rises every period it refuses one
attributes.why_no_one_else_holds_it: a surplus imprint is worthless to anybody climbing and dangerous to anybody governing, so the only safe custodian is one with no ambition on either side
attributes.the_family_cost: its members are the setting's only people for whom using the world's capacity is a moral event

name: The Cleft Ration House
summary: A house that holds no jade and owns the workings anyway, because jade holds qi and will not grow a crop, so whoever provisions the cutters owns the cleft more durably than whoever digs it. It exists because the cleft is the spirit tier's best refinement ground and its worst farming ground at once, and a title that depends on food outlasts a title that depends on a seam.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: economy.jade_ration: whoever provisions the workers owns the mine more durably
civilizations.jade_holdfast: the cleft's worst farming ground is what makes the title

attributes.what_the_house_holds: the ration contract, and with it the supply of every working series in the cleft
attributes.why_food_outranks_ore: a mine with nobody at it yields nothing while a store with nobody to eat from it is worthless inside a season, so the ration is the only claim both sides need
attributes.what_it_pays: the road in is one pass somebody else schedules, so the supply line is a calendar this house does not keep
attributes.the_family_cost: every series in the cleft eats before it is worked, and this house is named by name when the series come in thin

name: The Ridge Pass Holders
summary: A house that owns the ground on both sides of the only crossing of the Sixfold Ridge and grants passage across it rather than selling it. It exists because the two deposits on the ridge are one geological accident, so every claim on stone is a claim on jade and a claim on jade is a claim on the pass, and because a grant nobody has written down cannot be cited against the granter.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: geography.sixfold_ridge: the two deposits are one geological accident
organizations.jade_writ: a debt is marked on a tally cut with the debtor and kept by both

attributes.what_the_house_sells: nothing; it grants, and an unrecorded grant is unenforceable, which is the only reason the pass has never been closed by decree
attributes.how_it_stays_uncitable: no tally, no half-cut stick, nothing a court would prefer to a sealed instrument
attributes.what_the_house_takes_instead: the price is the granter's own standing on the far side, so the pass is settled in somebody else's good name
attributes.why_this_is_tenable: nobody may levy a seat, so there is no office to take the pass from, only a habit to break, and a habit needs somebody willing to keep it

name: The Saltledger Weight
summary: The household behind the counting house that decided access is the only thing worth fighting over. It exists because a house publishing credit, safe-conduct and trading posts against exclusivity can only be obeyed while every member refuses to carry a rival's goods, so the family spends its whole substance on an unwritten discipline and calls the result a road network.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: organizations.saltledger: a member will not carry a rival's goods
organizations.wide_door: a body that needs no road is the one thing the network cannot price

attributes.what_the_house_offers: credit, safe-conduct and trading posts, all three against exclusivity
attributes.what_exclusivity_costs_each_day: a member may not carry a rival's goods, so the price of the network is a refusal repeated at every load
attributes.why_the_household_and_not_the_guild_is_t: the guild is a purpose; this is the household that can be harmed by changing the purpose, and that is where the refusals are learned
attributes.what_it_owes: the roads, held only because enough carriers agree to use them and nobody has priced the agreement

name: The Quiet Head
summary: A house whose real figures live in the head of one member who is not permitted to write them down, so a raid finds nothing to cite and a counting house finds nothing to seize. It exists because the counting house that answers this one owns the roads, and a house that files everything is a house that cannot be left alone.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: cultures.quiet_count: keeping the house's real figures in one head, unwritten
economy.quiet_count_ledger: a house with nothing written has nothing to seize

attributes.what_is_written_down: the published half: technique, attendance, and a chamber to practise in
attributes.what_is_not: the real half, held by one person who may not record it and may not be relieved of it without losing it
attributes.why_concealment_is_purchased_not_chosen: the counting house publishes access against exclusivity, so a house that publishes its own numbers can be priced out of the only roads there are
attributes.the_cost_of_the_arrangement: a house with one unwritten mind has a single point of failure that cannot be backed up, copied or audited

name: The Refused Seat
summary: A house whose ancestor paid one period of the upkeep on an immortal seat and then stopped, which left the setting's only permanently refused office and a family that may not inherit it, sell it or walk away from it. It exists because the highest office may name a seat and may not take one, and that single sentence has a family on the wrong side of it.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: history.collapse_the_eighteenth_bed: upkeep claimed in arrears and never released
history.decree_the_unfilled_seats: self-appointment and reading vacancy as zero are both prohibited

attributes.what_the_house_is_left: a refusal it did not choose and cannot discharge
attributes.how_the_refusal_works: the ancestor's name is entered against a seat never certified empty, so the account runs forever and the house is cited on it
attributes.what_it_is_forbidden_from: naming it, taking it, or paying it down, all three of which would be self-appointment
attributes.the_cost_per_period: one entry in the tallies of the office that is allowed to name the seat and forbidden to take it

name: The Dry Salt Houses
summary: A standing set of marriages between the counting houses and the underwriters, kept because the two could not merge: a merger would make one of them priceable, and a priceable counterparty can be bought. It exists because elemental law is unwritten in the mortal tier, so nobody can forecast anything, and insurance is the only instrument left for the unknown.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: organizations.dry_salt_company: underwrites a caravan against a road closing
cultures.weight_and_name: a people that declined to price its cargo was never worth raiding

attributes.what_the_network_is: six marriages kept open across two counting houses, renewed whenever the houses would otherwise stop speaking
attributes.why_it_exists_instead_of_a_merge: an underwriter merged with a counting house is an underwriter with a price, and a price is a claim somebody can buy
attributes.what_it_buys: risk in both directions, so neither house has to hold enough unpriced cover to survive a bad season
attributes.the_price_the_network_pays: every marriage is a disclosure, so the network is only as private as the smallest house in it

name: The Tide Pass Marriages
summary: A set of marriages scheduled to the Tidemark rather than to a household's convenience, so that the wedding season and the crossing window are the same weeks. It exists because the spirit tier writes temporal law and therefore has a calendar, and a calendar is the first form of wealth, so the households that most want a good crossing date are the ones that fix the dates marriages happen on.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: geography.tidemark_climate: whoever reads the Tidemark sets the shipping dates
cultures.shore_notice: a community whose clock is two tides a day learned to speak in water

attributes.how_the_calendar_is_used: a wedding is booked against the anchor, and the anchor decides who is on the far side of the ridge at the same time
attributes.what_the_network_gives_up: the household chooses less about the timing than it would on the plains, which is the price of a date that actually holds
attributes.why_it_is_a_network_and_not_two_houses: the useful arrangement is a shared calendar across four households, and a single household can be scheduled by anybody
attributes.the_consequence: the best crossing weeks are booked years out, and a household that misses its slot waits a whole season

name: The Wardens of the Bed
summary: The households that stand at the abandoned crossing on the immortal border on behalf of nobody, because the office that would own it cannot be held by somebody unable to pay for it every period. It exists because a bed of unmortared seats is cheaper to keep standing than to fill, and a household at the far end of an unusable crossing is the only office the arrangement affords.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: history.collapse_the_eighteenth_bed: a seat cannot be held by somebody who cannot pay for it
organizations.bed_of_eighteen sells standing on the bed and is unmortarable

attributes.what_the_wardens_hold: the physical bed: a stretch of unmortared seats at realm eighteen that no institution can hold open
attributes.what_they_do_not_hold: authority; a bed of seats is not a crossing and that distinction is the whole of their standing
attributes.why_a_household_and_not_an_office: an office with upkeep in arrears is the exact mechanism that produced the bed, so the arrangement had to go to parties who cannot accrue anything
attributes.what_they_are_paid_in: attendance, since nobody may levy a seat and there is therefore nothing else to pay anybody with

name: The Overlayer Keepers
summary: Households that hold the Immortal Court's second layer on the Court's behalf, because ten seats over six groups leaves four duplicate imprints and a duplicate has to be carried by somebody. It exists because this is the only ground in the setting where a law is written twice and the second writing wins, so anything that must not fail is built here, which means the ground has a standing keeper and no owner.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: geography.overlayer_shelf: the second writing wins, so anything that must not fail is built here
geography.immortal_court: a duplicate needs somewhere to sit

attributes.what_the_household_carries: the duplicate imprints, on the surface, where a law is written twice and the second writing wins
attributes.why_it_cannot_own_the_ground: a custodian who claims the second writing inherits every dispute about it, and the Court's arrangement is that the surface has a keeper and no proprietor
attributes.what_is_built_on_it: everything in the setting that must not fail, which is why the household's standing is the highest on the court and its security the worst
attributes.the_second_duty: nothing that must fail is ever placed here; the deliberate failures go one layer down, and remembering which is which is the job

name: The Unfiled Names
summary: A line whose succession is agreed in a room and never written, because a family that cannot publish a roll cannot inherit by one either. It exists because a counting house that answers a carriage trade with prices at its own rates cannot enumerate a trade whose good is unrecorded, and the pressure from that side produced the most careful paperless practice in the setting.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: cultures.unfiled: changes of name held collectively, letters read and never kept
organizations.standing_name: a share transferred at the next re-drawing cannot be contested

attributes.how_succession_is_settled: agreed aloud in front of the community and carried by whoever re-draws the shares next
attributes.what_the_line_owns: nothing that could be cited, which is precisely why nothing of it can be seized either
attributes.the_cost_of_holding_nothing: a dispute cannot be settled from a document, so every disagreement has to be settled by the people standing there
attributes.why_it_is_a_bastard_line: the name changes are the point; a lineage that cannot be written is a lineage whose branches are all, formally, illegitimate

name: The March Bastards
summary: The children of the levy: called, fed, trained, and entered nowhere, because the March may call a levy and may not own a body. It exists because the levy is answered by people who may say no, which only works if the marshalled are not already the marshals' subjects, so the setting has to raise people it is forbidden to keep.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: civilizations.marshal: authority over passage, never authority over a body
organizations.ninth_watch: the only standing force on the plains, posted at the foot of the stair

attributes.what_the_house_is: a set of households that raise the called and enter none of them
attributes.how_a_child_becomes_marched: by being called, which is a duty and not a claim, so the family is a duty with a house attached
attributes.what_it_owns: a training ground and a name; the levy's name is on no roll, including this one
attributes.why_it_is_not_an_orphanage: an orphanage holds children nobody has a duty to; these are held by people who have a duty and may not own what they hold

name: The Tideborn Keep
summary: The one household that has held the oldest recorded carrier line so long that the name stopped describing a family and started describing a body. It exists because two generations of pure pairing is the ceiling of an unbroken chain, so the house spends its whole substance refusing to marry out, and the refusal is the only reason the line still has an unbroken record at all.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: races.tideborn: kept in one household so long the name stopped describing a family
lore/prose/history/consequence_the_unowned_genealogy: the competing claim is a memory, not an arithmetic

attributes.what_the_household_protects: the chain, not the estate; the land is incidental and the line is the reason it is held
attributes.the_pure_pairing_rule: two generations and no more, which is the arithmetic ceiling rather than a preference
attributes.what_the_house_gives_up: every advantage a marriage would bring, including access to roads held by the families it declines to join
attributes.why_the_record_cannot_be_proved: its own record begins after the culls, so the oldest surviving carrier entry it holds is also the entry that cannot establish priority

name: The Ember Cradle
summary: The household that made the one crossing between a burning body and a mineral one, and has held the result as a single thin concentration ever since. It exists because the crossing was made once at a founding generation and never repeated, so the line is unevenly spread and unevenly read, and a household holding a thin line is one that cannot spend it twice.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: races.emberborn: crossed at one conception with the stone line and never again
cosmology.mortal_law_availability: elemental, spatial and temporal are never written below the spirit tier

attributes.the_crossing_that_made_it: one conception shared with the stone line at a founding generation, never repeated since
attributes.what_the_line_grants: a defensive continuous burn rather than a larger reserve, which is a slower fire and not a bigger one
attributes.why_it_is_never_strengthened: a second crossing would average the concentration into the general population and the thin line would vanish into the common hearthborn reading
attributes.what_the_house_holds_instead: the memory of the single crossing, which is the only asset that cannot be diluted

name: The Hearth Common
summary: The household that carries the most ordinary concentration in the setting and has no bloodline of its own, only a habit of averaging whatever the household took in. It exists because a common line is common by being dependable rather than strong, and a family whose only distinction is reliability has to be everywhere, which is why there are more of its children than of any other line.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: races.hearthborn: the default concentration of long-settled households, common because it is dependable
civilizations.ford_assembly: the only boundary fact anybody can prove on the plains

attributes.what_the_house_carries: the default concentration, carefully kept, averaged with whatever the household took in, and unsurprising as a reading
attributes.what_the_grant_is: small on purpose: a little reserve and a little qi recovery, nothing that decides a fight
attributes.why_it_is_a_household_and_not_a_village: a concentration that averages is not inherited as a property but as a practice, and a practice needs a house that keeps doing it
attributes.what_it_gains: the only line most people will ever hold, and the only one whose members are never exceptional in any direction

name: The Unowned Genealogy
summary: The line with no recorded origin and no household that will claim it, whose founding bar sits at a height the arithmetic says exactly one generation of pure-by-pure inheritance can clear. It exists because a cull deliberately destroys the record of what was culled, which would make this line a debt somebody else's descendants are still paying, and because two records, one of them arithmetic and one of them memory, cannot be reconciled by any authority here.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: lore/prose/history/consequence_the_unowned_genealogy: recorded rather than resolved
races.voidborn: the bar is set so one generation of pure pairing is the only way clear it

attributes.the_arithmetic: the bar sits where one generation of pure-by-pure inheritance is the only pairing that clears it, and anything weaker is unobtainable
attributes.the_competing_record: one household has held the oldest surviving carrier entry so long that the name stopped describing a family, and it cannot prove it is older because its record begins after the culls
attributes.why_it_is_unresolved: a cull is a political act and never an anatomical one, so the narrowed pool may cross any race and no record survives to say whose it was
attributes.what_would_settle_it: a descent somebody can corroborate; none exists, and inventing one would be the only way to close it, which is why it stays open

name: The Void Deniers
summary: Households whose founding rule is to refuse any claim that clears the void bar, so the line that clears it stays unattributed. It exists because the setting's own arithmetic needs a founding line to be reachable and its own history needs that line to have no owner, and a refusal written down is the only thing that can keep both true at once.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: races.voidborn: no recorded origin and no household that will admit to it
history.founding_the_first_tier: no surviving record names the payer

attributes.the_rule: a body that clears the founding bar is entered nowhere, by any household, under any name
attributes.how_the_rule_is_kept: by inspection at the threshold where the measurement is taken, which is the only point at which a refusal can be enforced
attributes.what_the_rule_buys: the arithmetic stays reachable, because a ladder whose top rung is provably clearable is a ladder somebody will attempt
attributes.what_it_costs_the_house: a member who clears the bar is told at the door and cannot be told at home, so the household is the one place the news is forbidden
attributes.why_it_is_not_a_story_about_them: there is nothing to know; the record is empty by rule, and any account of who they are would be a claim the rule exists to refuse

name: The First Ascent
summary: The household that left the plains for the Spirit Peaks first and kept both claims: the queue position below and the house above. It exists because the movement was economic before it was spiritual and nobody who climbed ever gave up the lower claim, so this is the only lineage in the setting with a household on two tiers and a grievance on three.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: history.migration_the_peak_ascent: spirit stone and jade cannot be found below the spirit tier
economy.ladder_price: a figure quoted in one tier's weights is meaningless in the next

attributes.what_the_line_holds: a tenure slot on the plains it cannot farm and a house on the peaks it cannot leave
attributes.why_two_claims: a figure quoted in the plains' weights is meaningless in the peaks, so a family that could not price the move keeps both ledgers rather than convert either
attributes.the_line_cost: it is answerable to two law budgets at once and reads as unplaced in both
attributes.what_it_pays_the_plains: the gate fee, because a body from a world with a larger budget is a visitor wherever it happens to stand

name: The Gale Heirs
summary: The second house on the ridge, holding the pass ground while the calendar sits with the reeves. It exists because a family holding both the ground and the schedule would be unassailable, so the ground was given away deliberately and the two houses have agreed for three generations to argue only about price.

provenance.author: w6-families
basis: history.discovery_the_passage_ledger: passage is the only supply chain whose unit is a person
geography.gale_pass: the setting's first choke point and the only supply route to the cleft

attributes.what_the_line_holds: the ground either side of the pass and the right to say no
attributes.what_it_gave_away_and_why: the schedule, because the holder of a date becomes responsible for it, and a family responsible for a closure is a family that can be blamed for one
attributes.the_arrangement: the ground sets the price and the calendar sets the date, so neither house can stop a crossing and both can be blamed for one
attributes.what_the_line_owes: the pass must be re-surveyed every period, because a surveyed pass can be closed and an unsurveyed one can only be argued about
